headline: Exploring the Best Non-Marvel Superhero Shows
post:
While Marvel and DC usually dominate the conversation, the superhero genre extends far beyond the Big Two. According to /Film, fantastic series outside of the traditional comic giants highlight just how diverse these stories truly can be. From animated classics to ambitious streaming hits, various networks and platforms have delivered memorable takes on super-powered characters.

Fans of quirky family dynamics might remember "The Umbrella Academy," a four-season Netflix show centering on adopted siblings raised as superheroes. Meanwhile, viewers looking for comedy and intense action can revisit "The Powerpuff Girls," Cartoon Network's hit 1998 series where three sisters defend their hometown from supervillains before bedtime. Other standout titles range from the postmodern streaming drama "Raising Dion" to the brilliant anime parody "One-Punch Man."

Which of these non-Marvel or DC superhero shows is your absolute favorite to binge-watch over the weekend?

#SuperheroTV #TheUmbrella Academy #GeekCulture
original_title: 10 Best Superhero TV Shows Not Made By Marvel Or DC, Ranked

headline: Martian Manhunter's true strength over Superman
post:
Hey DC fans! According to Screen Rant, even the Man of Steel once admitted that J'onn J'onzz is "the strongest being on Earth". That is a huge title to hold in the Justice League.

While Superman acts as a living solar battery who continually absorbs yellow sunlight, Martian Manhunter has incredible shapeshifting capabilities. J'onn can alter his bodily density, expand his limbs, and grow additional muscle tissue to deliver devastating blows during a fight. He also possesses an impressive set of abilities including telepathy, invisibility, and intangibility.

At the same time, Superman eventually outmatches him due to his ongoing combat experience and continuous power growth. It is fascinating to look back at how these two powerhouses compare after all these years.

Which Justice League hero do you think is stronger than Superman?

#Superman #MartianManhunter #JusticeLeague
original_title: 71 Years Later, It's Clear Only One Justice League Superhero Is Truly Stronger Than Superman
